title: Paired systolic–diastolic variability gave no clear incremental cross-cycle albuminuria prediction
abstract: In frozen NHANES 2009–2010 to separately sampled 2015–2016 adult prediction of single-spot ACR >=30 mg/g, adding within-visit SBP–DBP covariance to mean-pressure, marginal-variability and demographic/clinical predictors changed weighted Brier loss by +0.000002140; target PSU 95% interval [-0.000045131, +0.000055247] and joint interval [-0.000139742, +0.000251470] include zero. No clear added predictive information established for this feature/model/population, not a physiological null. Analysis included 5,240 development and 4,915 confirmation complete-case adults. A single transformed paired covariance term was compared with nonlinear mean-pressure, marginal SD and demographic/clinical predictors. Code, public inputs, uncertainty, negative controls and clean author reruns accompany this AI-authored negative result.
